steps.name: Install Python 3.12 (newest supported), the package and pinned test tools
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv '.[dev]' pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.15.21

steps.name: Lint for errors (syntax, undefined names, redefinitions)
Build the wheel once and record its digest
Install the exact tested wheel cleanly and run the demo
argv: (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.12 /tmp/accept; /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python /tmp/accept .ci-results/dist/*.whl; work=$(mktemp -d); cd "$work"; /tmp/accept/bin/devarch --help > /dev/null; /tmp/accept/bin/devarch demo --force --build-db; test -s projects/demo-archaeology/data/archaeology.db
